notes.title: Achievements are now in!
notes.content:
🚀 Achievements are here!
The SOS Incident Demo and Main App now feature 10 unique achievements to unlock. They’re hidden across the game and reward those who explore, experiment, and push their limits. Think you’ve got what it takes to find them all? 🌟
[olist]
 Start the Game - Welcome Back 

Secret tape - There is a Mystery in The Woods 

Clean up trash - Eco Friendly 

Played the game for 15min - Enjoying The Game 

Played the game for 30min - Taking it Slow 

Lighting a Huge Fire - Staying Warm 

Found all Secret Tapes - True Detective 

Survived the Demo - True Survivor 

Found the Shortcut - Eagle Eye 

Avoid the crash - Be you can't
[/olist]
